measurement.interfaces: Final native registered/model-bound schemas for four report roles and separate learner, including framework tools. Host APIs separate. Text-tool is not a decision agent.
measurement.configuration: List legal managed/reference/decision_only/learning/optional capability combinations; do not require impossible cartesian products.
measurement.paths: 24 explicit critical protocol families; state list is the initial agreed denominator, not all mathematical program paths.
measurement.conditions: 18 risk-selected decision groups, not exhaustive all-src conditions. MC/DC requires decision-local feasible independent pairs; no current percentage claimed.
measurement.branch: Main reports complete src statement/branch and active/retired applicability separately. coverage.py cannot establish MC/DC.
measurement.safety: No product edits/instrumentation yet. Main tests only with temporary stores, fake models, network denied and MockTransport allowed. No live Store/Workspace construction, paid call, migration or original ledger mutation.
measurement.evidence: Test names map candidates only. Verify actual parameter-expanded nodeid, assertions/outcome and hashes. Previous green and source reads are not current runtime baseline.
measurement.platform: Fake injection can bypass configured adapter. Require explicit configured_model+MockTransport and native ToolNode/middleware/serializer paths. Third-party internals outside application branch denominator.
